note: The frozen 15 electrical pricing categories (Rebuild Spec v2.0 / Design doc §20). 'novel' is RETIRED -- ABSTAIN returns a BLANK category_id (""), see scoring.json novel_category_id + runner.py. Build 2b removed the two transitional categories: 'termination' was MERGED into wiring_cabling ('Wiring, Cabling & Termination') and 'networking' was REMOVED (cross-discipline -> data lines route to blank). This list is now exactly the frozen 15. category_id is stable; descriptions are the human/AI reference (the prompt-2 harness reads this file).

categories.name: Switches and Sockets
categories.description: Modular switches, sockets, plates, cover/blanking plates.

categories.name: CableTray & Raceway
categories.description: Cable trays, raceways, trunking, ladders, tray covers.

categories.name: Wiring, Cabling & Termination
categories.description: Bare cable/wire runs sized by conductor, sub-mains/feeders, lugs, glands, end terminations.

categories.name: Junction Box for Raceway
categories.description: Junction/pull/draw boxes for raceway/cable systems (own priced category).

categories.name: EARTHING
categories.description: Earth strips, electrodes, pits, earth wire, earth bus.

categories.name: Point Wiring
categories.description: A point/circuit wired as a unit (light/fan/outlet points), including its conduit/switch/wiring; the point framing overrides component words.

categories.name: Pop up Boxes
categories.description: Pop-up/floor socket boxes, flip-flop boxes, table/floor outlet units.

categories.name: UPS
categories.description: UPS units, UPS batteries, and UPS accessories (incl. SNMP/BMS cards for a UPS).

categories.name: Lighting Management system
categories.description: Lighting control systems/processors, DALI, occupancy/daylight sensors for lighting.

categories.name: Miscellaneous
categories.description: A positive placement for genuine electrical items fitting no other category (NOT a fallback for uncertainty).

categories.name: Light Fixtures
categories.description: Luminaires/fixtures: LED, panel lights, downlighters, battens, decorative/street/flood lights.
